decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already captures the candidate-specific LDO, activation, load, OR-ing, and normal-source effects.
The existing same-message MODIFY already captures the newly specified converter rating and powered loads; the AXP2101 system power path does not alter the rail's existing switching behavior.
The existing same-message MODIFY captures the SK6812 family, while the conditional phrase about 5V wiring does not establish a definite LED-board supply requirement.
The existing same-message MODIFY already captures the identified I2C modules and their 3.3V supply through the sensor board.
The battery voltage and AXP2101 power path do not change the connector's physical placement, orientation, spacing, or mounting-hole clearance.
The source specifies battery voltage and system power flow but does not resolve or change the battery connector series, mounting type, or disputed pinout.
The electrical power-path clarification does not change any board dimensions, mounting features, connector placement, or enclosure-fit constraints.
The source identifies power components and topology but makes no decision about component availability, sourcing, compatibility, or cost.
The source explains which rails power system loads but does not change the established interboard connector types, pinouts, or matching-pin-order rule.
The sensor supply clarification does not alter I2C cable length, bus speed, pull-up resistance or location, or series-resistor policy.
The power-path clarification does not change BOM completeness, part-number requirements, or the recorded R6 assembly settings.
The source makes no decision about KiCad library portability, footprint resolution, or project-file packaging.
